shortDescription: List and filter on Alert Definitions. WARNING! This module makes use of beta endpoints and requires the C(api_version) field be explicitly set to C(v4beta).

options.name: count
options.description: The number of Alert Definitions to return. If undefined, all results will be returned.

options.name: filters
options.description: A list of filters to apply to the resulting Alert Definitions.

options.name: order
options.description: The order to list Alert Definitions in.

options.name: order_by
options.description: The attribute to order Alert Definitions by.
